experiment: read each movement predicate, then move: the shift/sweep/swap schedule
kickmix_role: local rebuild with MR and per-instruction execution counts (scripts/build_kickmix_mr.py); not the pinned competition binary

prediction.schedule_change: read the movement predicate classically, then move: the register is a basis state, so the read is deterministic and the movement is skipped exactly on the shots whose own predicate is zero

S1_sweep.hypothesis: the quotient selection is one-hot: at most two of the emitted positions carry it in a live round, so every other chain cswap is a quantum-controlled no-op
S1_sweep.promotion_rule: the chain must fall by at least 90% of its headroom

S2_shift.hypothesis: do_shift is the XOR of three threshold intervals, so the firing set is the active window and a saving is NOT predicted; the measurement decides

S3_swap.hypothesis: the exchange is gated on c3 and flag, which is disjoint from the shift's c1 ∨ c2 ∨ (¬flag ∧ (c0 ∨ c3)) because ctrl is one-hot and the flag is one value

S4_products.hypothesis: the product's `mul` control is the multiply window, not a one-hot, so the saving is whatever the window excludes; no figure is predicted
S4_products.why_it_is_here: beyond the reviewer's two priorities, but the same read-then-gate argument applies to the product's own control, so leaving it unmeasured would leave the reachability arithmetic resting on an untested assumption

S3b_shift_c3_branch.hypothesis: dropping the shift in every c3 round (as a schedule that treats the exchange as covering it would) saves 0.0 and stays correct, because the flag is set in those rounds

relocation.question: does the Toffoli saving relocate work rather than remove it
relocation.declared: every read is one cx plus one mr, so the added cost is two instructions per read and is counted under `predicate_read`; the arm's total executed instruction count is reported beside its Toffoli count for every arm
relocation.predicted: executed Toffolis fall by the gated work; executed instructions fall by the same gates and rise by 2 per read

falsifiers.falsify_sweep_stale: condition each selection on the previous position's bit, so the quotient swap never happens where it is needed: must fail
falsifiers.falsify_shift_complement: condition each move on the complement of its own mask, so it is always skipped: must fail
falsifiers.falsify_shift_stale: condition each shift move on the previous slot's mask, so the window moves by the wrong slot: must fail

S5_stack.declared_by: the reviewer, 2026-10-30, from the two separate records
S5_stack.hypothesis: the five gates act on disjoint work: the three schedule gates remove movement and product no-ops, the two flag/metadata gates remove update work in dead rounds, so the stack saves the sum and the Toffolis do not interact
S5_stack.falsifier: an increment over `everything` that differs from the prior arm's saving by more than one Toffoli means the two gates interact, and the sum is wrong

round_overlap.note: counts are executions summed over the shot batch, so a round shows both only if the two regions execute in the same run; the composed arm and its falsifier carry the per-shot half of the claim
